grh_0eef7409c529e7a7b172.title: Remember the Night
paragraphs: Assistant district attorney John Sargent prosecutes shoplifter Lee Leander just before Christmas, then delays the case when he realizes a holiday jury may acquit her out of sympathy. Feeling guilty about leaving her jailed over Christmas, he arranges bail and, learning she grew up near his own Indiana home, takes her along for the holiday. John's warm family gives Lee the first real sense of belonging she has known, and she and John fall in love. He even offers her the chance to remain across the Canadian border, but Lee refuses to damage the career he worked so hard to build. Back in court John subtly tries to lose the case, so Lee stops him by pleading guilty. Before sentencing he asks her to marry him; she chooses to serve her time first, certain that if he still wants her afterward they can begin honestly and as equals.
